From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Tuesday, September 11, 2018 11:31 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: FW: Job candidate 
 
Do you want to take our job candidate out to lunch tomorrow?

From: Thomas, Christopher 
Sent: Tuesday, September 11, 2018 11:30 AM
To: Farrell, Perry <pafarrell@freepress.com>; Ellis, Vince <vellis@freepress.com>; Sulonen, Dana <DSulonen@freepress.com>; Alter, Marlowe <malter@freepress.com>; Baumgardner, Nicholas <NBaumgardn@freepress.com>; Birkett, David <dbirkett@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>; Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Ford, Ryan <rford@freepress.com>; Monarrez, Carlos <cmonarrez@freepress.com>; Seidel, Jeff <jseidel@freepress.com>; 'Sipple, George' <gsipple@freepress.com>; Solari, Chris <CSOLARI@lsj.com>; St. James, Helene <hstjames@freepress.com>; Windsor, Shawn <swindsor@freepress.com>
Subject: Job candidate
All: Aaron Torres is interviewing for the open position we have in sports.
Aaron is a Texas graduate and John Lowe disciple who has a passion for baseball writing.
He spent last summer at the Washington Post as an intern, and in 2016 he interned at the Tampa Bay Times.
Aaron has family in Detroit and will be interviewing on Wednesday.
Please let me know soon if you would like to meet with him.
